svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. svg.text: Prime P11 artwork; GF pins also match P12
Power off before wiring: EXT_INPUT1 1–2; COIL_SOURCE1 1–2; HOST_ARM1 unfitted.
Do not connect an external load supply. Tester joins common/NO only; NC is unused.
M106.9 requests coil ON; M107.9 requests OFF. Reserve PB1 and these commands first.
Terminals are electrical symbols, not cavity positions. Verify actual pin numbering and supplies.
Solid wires are external conductors. Board artwork is context; no internal PCB routes are redrawn.
